mapper.select: SELECT ID FROM PEACH_TENANT WHERE ID = #{tenantRefId} AND TENANT_CODE = 'PLATFORM' AND STATUS = 'ENABLE' AND IS_DELETE = 0

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM PEACH_TENANT_MEMBER M INNER JOIN PEACH_TENANT T ON T.ID = M.TENANT_REF_ID AND T.TENANT_CODE = 'PLATFORM' AND T.STATUS = 'ENABLE' AND T.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_USER U ON U.ID = M.USER_REF_ID AND U.STATUS IN ('1', 'ENABLE') AND U.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_APPLICATION A ON A.ID = #{appRefId} AND A.TENANT_ID = T.TENANT_ID AND A.IS_OPEN = 1 AND A.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_MEMBER_ROLE_BINDING B ON B.TENANT_REF_ID = M.TENANT_REF_ID AND B.MEMBER_REF_ID = M.ID AND B.APP_REF_ID = A.ID AND B.SCOPE_TYPE = 'TENANT' AND B.SCOPE_REF_ID IS NULL AND B.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND B.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_ROLE R ON R.ID = B.ROLE_REF_ID AND R.TENANT_REF_ID = T.ID AND R.APP_REF_ID = A.ID AND R.ROLE_TYPE = 'SYSTEM' AND R.ROLE_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND R.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_ROLE_PERMISSION RP ON RP.ROLE_REF_ID = R.ID AND RP.TENANT_REF_ID = T.ID AND RP.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND RP.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_PERMISSION_DEFINITION P ON P.ID = RP.PERMISSION_REF_ID AND P.OWNER_TYPE = 'SYSTEM' AND P.TENANT_REF_ID IS NULL AND P.APP_REF_ID IS NULL AND P.DELEGABLE = 0 AND P.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'API' AND P.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND P.IS_DELETE = 0 WHERE M.ID = #{memberRefId} AND M.TENANT_REF_ID = #{tenantRefId} AND M.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND M.IS_DELETE = 0 AND M.VERSION = #{memberVersion} AND M.AUTH_VERSION = #{authVersion} AND P.PERMISSION_CODE = 'PLATFORM.CODE.RULE.MANAGE'
